data.one_liner: A Dart and Flutter library for Bluesky Social and the AT Protocol.
data.what_it_does: Provides complete API coverage for Bluesky Social, AT Protocol, chat, and Ozone moderation tools. It handles user authentication, feeds, profiles, and real-time event firehoses.
use_when: You are building an application specifically for Bluesky Social.
You need to integrate AT Protocol services, feeds, or chat functionality.
avoid_when: You are building a general REST or GraphQL backend application unrelated to Bluesky.
You only need standard Firebase or Supabase authentication and storage.
strengths: Complete coverage of app.bsky, chat.bsky, and tools.ozone endpoints.
Supports advanced authentication including session management and OAuth DPoP.
Includes client-side notification grouping and real-time firehose support.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to Bluesky and AT Protocol specifications.
Relies on external code generation annotations for data models.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency via pub add and initialize the client using either basic credentials or OAuth.
